description: Drivability on seed 7. Targets: max roll <= 20 deg, max pitch <= 25 deg, flips = 0. The route includes ramming the opponent on the forward leg. Recorded browser runs on 2026-09-23 measured roll 5.7-8.4 deg, pitch 10.4-15.1 deg, 0 flips and 0 airborne frames. Historical regression bounds remain alongside the stricter targets.
